name: pw_limits: range with 'between ... and'

args.text:
Create an account
Email address
Password
Your password must be between 8 and 18 characters.

spec_quote: A range: "between 8 and 18 characters", "8-18 characters", "8 – 18 characters", "8 to 18 characters" → [8, 18].

name: pw_limits: hyphen range with 'chars' and other non-length rules

args.text: Password hint: 10-20 chars. Must contain at least 1 uppercase letter, at least 1 digit and 1 special character.

spec_quote: A range: "between 8 and 18 characters", "8-18 characters", "8 – 18 characters", "8 to 18 characters" → [8, 18]. ... "chars" counts as "characters". ... A number not followed by "characters" / "chars" (e.g. "at least 1 uppercase letter", "18 years of age") is not a length rule.

name: pw_limits: 'fewer than 19 characters' is max 18

args.text: Your new password must be fewer than 19 characters.

spec_quote: "fewer than 19 characters" / "less than 19 characters" → max 18 (strictly fewer).

name: pw_limits: min only, uppercase rule is not a length rule

args.text:
Password
Must be at least 8 characters
Must contain at least 1 uppercase letter
Must contain at least 1 number

spec_quote: A minimum alone: "at least 8 characters", ... → min 8. ... A number not followed by "characters" / "chars" (e.g. "at least 1 uppercase letter", "18 years of age") is not a length rule.

name: pw_limits: range plus smaller separate maximum

args.text: Passwords must be 8-18 characters long. For this site your password must not exceed 12 characters.

spec_quote: When the page states both a range and a separate maximum, the smaller maximum wins; a separate minimum and a range → the larger minimum wins.

name: pw_limits: separate minimum plus range, larger minimum wins

args.text:
Password must be at least 6 characters.
SuccessFactors passwords are 8 to 18 characters.

spec_quote: When the page states both a range and a separate maximum, the smaller maximum wins; a separate minimum and a range → the larger minimum wins.

name: pw_limits: age restriction and letter rule are not length rules

args.text: You must be at least 18 years of age to register. Password must contain at least 1 uppercase letter.

spec_quote: A number not followed by "characters" / "chars" (e.g. "at least 1 uppercase letter", "18 years of age") is not a length rule.

name: pw_limits: line breaks and mixed case, separate min and max

args.text:
PASSWORD REQUIREMENTS
Your password must be at least 12 characters
and it can be UP TO 30 characters.

spec_quote: Case and extra spaces / line breaks do not matter. ... A maximum alone: ... "up to 18 characters" ... → max 18. ... A minimum alone: "at least 8 characters" ... → min 8.

name: pick_password: range 8-18, first stored password (8 chars) fits

args.text: Password must be between 8 and 18 characters.

spec_quote: Return the FIRST pair whose password length fits the rule from `pw_limits(text)` (length ≥ min when min is stated, ≤ max when max is stated; both bounds inclusive).

name: pick_password: min 10 skips 8-char, uses 12-char

args.text: Password must be at least 10 characters and contain 1 digit.

spec_quote: Return the FIRST pair whose password length fits the rule from `pw_limits(text)` (length ≥ min when min is stated, ≤ max when max is stated; both bounds inclusive).

name: pick_password: max 12 excludes 16-char, 12-char exactly fits

args.text: Your password cannot exceed 12 characters.

spec_quote: length ≥ min when min is stated, ≤ max when max is stated; both bounds inclusive

name: pick_password: between 10 and 12, nothing fits (8 and 16)

args.text: Password must be between 10 and 12 characters.

spec_quote: When nothing fits, return null.

name: pick_password: empty password never fits, 8-char min uses 8-char

args.text: Password must be at least 8 characters.

spec_quote: An empty password never fits. ... Return the FIRST pair whose password length fits the rule

name: pick_password: no rule on page, first non-empty (8 chars) used

args.text:
Create an account
Email address
Confirm email address
First name
Last name

spec_quote: With no rule on the page, the first non-empty password is used.

args.text: ACCEPT THE PRIVACY STATEMENT

spec_quote: "Accept the privacy statement" ... Case and spacing do not matter.

name: privacy_link: 'Review our privacy notice'

args.text: Review our privacy notice

spec_quote: "View the privacy policy", "Review our privacy notice", "Open the data privacy agreement"

name: privacy_link: 'Open the data privacy agreement'

name: privacy_link: 'Privacy' alone is false

args.text: Privacy

spec_quote: False for text that does not name a privacy statement / agreement / policy / notice (e.g. "Terms of use", "Read the job description", "Create an account", "Privacy" alone, "Cookie settings").

name: privacy_link: 'Terms of use' is false

args.text: By creating an account you agree to the Terms of use.

spec_quote: False for text that does not name a privacy statement / agreement / policy / notice (e.g. "Terms of use", ...)

name: radio_question: question text is the first enclosing text

texts: Make My Profile Visible to Any Acme recruiter worldwide Any Acme recruiter in my country/region Only recruiters managing jobs I apply to
options: Any Acme recruiter in my country/region
Only recruiters managing jobs I apply to

spec_quote: The first text that still contains a word of two or more letters and is at most 250 characters long is the question; return it.

name: radio_question: only option texts remain, returns empty

texts: Any Acme recruiter worldwide Any Acme recruiter in my country/region Only recruiters managing jobs I apply to
options: Any Acme recruiter in my country/region
Only recruiters managing jobs I apply to

spec_quote: Return "" when no text qualifies (all empty, only option texts, or every remaining text longer than 250 characters).

name: radio_question: only text is longer than 250 characters

texts: Choose who can see your profile. Make My Profile Visible to any Acme recruiter worldwide, any Acme recruiter in my country or region, or only recruiters managing the jobs you apply to. You can change this setting at any time from your account preferences page.

spec_quote: Return "" when no text qualifies (all empty, only option texts, or every remaining text longer than 250 characters).

name: radio_question: leading required star and trailing colon with extra whitespace

options: Any Acme recruiter in my country/region
Only recruiters managing jobs I apply to

spec_quote: Go through `texts` in order; remove every option text from it (longer options first), then drop a leading required star "*", a trailing colon and extra whitespace.

name: radio_question: longer option removed first leaves nothing
spec_quote: remove every option text from it (longer options first)

name: radio_question: empty texts and single letter only, returns empty
spec_quote: The first text that still contains a word of two or more letters and is at most 250 characters long is the question; return it. Return "" when no text qualifies
